name: stress-ng tsc
description: Start N workers that read the Time Stamp Counter (TSC) 256 times per loop iteration (bogo operation). This exercises the tsc instruction for x86, the mftb instruction for ppc64, the rdcycle instruction for RISC-V, the tick instruction on SPARC and the rdtime.d instruction for Loong64. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
